headline: Home sides win every match on conference opening night
dek: Fort Hays State, Southern Nazarene and Newman each won at home on Thursday as conference play began. Newman's win ended a run of five straight defeats, and Fort Hays State's followed two draws. Rogers State, unbeaten through their first five matches, have now lost two in a row.
displaced_by: conference play opened on 2026-09-17 and the home side won every match

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State have outscored Newman and Northeastern State put together.

wire.line: Newman ended a run of five straight defeats by beating Northeastern State on the first night of conference play.

last_match.line: Newman's first win since their opening night at William Jewell; Northeastern State's only win remains the one over Oklahoma Christian.

next_match.line: Ouachita Baptist play their first conference match, with no result published for them since they won at Hendrix; Southern Nazarene arrive on back-to-back wins.
